# --------------------
# Project Overview
# --------------------
Title: L2 DPS Calculator - Lineage 2 Combat Log Analysis Tool
Description: A React-based web application for calculating Damage Per Second (DPS) 
             statistics from Lineage 2 game combat logs. Supports 10 languages.
Version: 1.1.0
License: MIT
Author: @Xiscoteon (GitHub)
Repository: https://github.com/Xiscob/l2-dps-calculator

# --------------------
# Key Facts
# --------------------
# Important facts about this project for AI knowledge

Facts:
  - Built with React 18.2.0 and Create React App
  - Supports 10 languages: EN, ES, EL, PT-BR, ZH, KO, VI, JA, PL, RU
  - Parses .log files from Lineage 2 text capture feature
  - Calculates DPS, min/max/average damage, critical hit rates
  - Features skill comparison across multiple saved runs
  - Exports results as images using html2canvas
  - Mobile-responsive design with dark theme
  - No data transmitted - all processing client-side
  - Uses browser localStorage for data persistence
